title: Possible Stories: Evaluating Situated Commonsense Reasoning under Multiple Possible Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis and human validation to identify and filter out unconscious gender stereotypes (e.g., assumptions about traditional gender roles or domestic skills) in crowdsourced story contexts and endings.
